name: What is considered a high-end home, and how does its construction differ from standard homes?

mainEntity.name: What is considered a high-end home, and how does its construction differ from standard homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: A high-end home is characterized by superior architectural design, premium materials, advanced technology, and bespoke craftsmanship. Construction involves meticulous planning, custom features, and often includes specialized systems like smart home integration, energy-efficient solutions, and complex structural elements. Unlike standard homes, high-end projects prioritize unique aesthetics, durability, and a highly personalized living experience, requiring a greater level of detail, skilled labor, and project management throughout every phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-end homes feature superior design, premium materials, advanced technology, and bespoke craftsmanship, differing from standard homes through meticulous planning and custom features.
